messages:
maria: Quick sync — building a per-1000-token unit-econ dashboard for Console + API. Need clarity on runtime/infra inputs we can ship to telemetry. High level metrics: cost_per_1k_tokens, cache_savings_pct, batching_savings_pct, average_gpu_ms_per_1k, fallback_cost_delta. Thoughts?

kevin: +1. From infra we need: request.tokens.input, request.tokens.output, runtime.gpu_ms, cache.hit (bool), batch.size, model.variant, quantized (bool), region, routing.policy

jules: Also include kv_cache_prefix_hits and queued_latency_ms (so we can attribute latency vs savings). Maybe `cache.tier` (memory/disk).

maria: nice. How about ties to billing? we need per-request cost model: cost = gpu_ms * gpu_cost_per_ms + memory_cost + infra_overhead. Do we have gpu_cost_per_ms per pool?

sam: infra: we expose pool_id and executor_type. gpu_cost_per_ms is derived from pool config; will add `pool.cost_profile` in the hook.

infra-bot: Deploy note: telemetry ingestion sidecar rollout starts tomorrow to add these fields. schema v2.14.

ana: Product: dashboard must let PMs slice by customer_tier, route_policy (latency/cost/region), and canary vs prod. Also need 95th perc.

kevin: For dashboard queries I'd prefer precomputed rollups per 1k token window to avoid heavy joins. Example SQL:

```
SELECT
  model_variant,
  sum(gpu_ms) / (sum(tokens)/1000) AS avg_gpu_ms_per_1k,
  sum(cost) / (sum(tokens)/1000) AS cost_per_1k,
  sum(CASE WHEN cache.hit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(*) AS cache_hit_rate
FROM telemetry.events_v2
WHERE ts >= $__from AND ts <= $__to
GROUP BY model_variant;
```

jules: + please add `route.fallback` boolean so we can measure when we fall back to cheaper model.

maria: UX: Console needs a small explainer for "cache savings" calculation and a toggle to view raw per-request distribution. Also link to rollout ID when it's from canary.

sam: Ops: We'll attach `rollout_id` and `route.decision` to each event.

kevin: One question: how do we attribute savings for batching? If multiple requests in batch, token share matters. Proposal: attribute batch GPU_ms proportionally by tokens in each request.

maria: That works. Add note for evals: mark `eval.flag` for synthetic runs so dashboards can exclude them.

jules: Timeline: infra to ship schema by Thu, ingestion backfill for last 30d, dashboard proto early next week.

ana: Can we add a cost estimate widget per-customer using commit tiers? PM asks for "what-if" slider for batch size improvements.

maria: We'll prototype with sample customers. Thanks all, I'll reserve follow-up doc and assign owners.

kevin: I'll file the telemetry PR + schema doc today. sam: I'll do sidecar rollout.

infra-bot: Action items created: #1234 (telemetry schema), #1235 (sidecar rollout), #1236 (dashboard proto).

maria: Great :thumbsup:
